"""Explicit, one-time copy-only producer migration. Never modifies the old root."""
import copy,hashlib,json,os,pathlib,shutil,torch
from samudra.experiments.observation_joint import assert_exact_state
from samudra.experiments.observation_pilot import atomic_json,atomic_torch,digest
from scripts.run_early_fine_wave import ARMS
old=pathlib.Path('/scratch/jr7309/runs/2026-10-08-early-fine-rtx/recovery-replay')
new=old.parent/'recovery-observation-cache'
old_producer='030c96ec7205ab87f38f9cdf132d07a282db7602'
producer='8c9a7403edbcd3a37fe09c3af687cbb99a62be85'
assert json.loads((new/'paths.json').read_text())['producer']==producer
# New fitting, exact replay and I/O equality gates must pass for every arm.
for arm,(architecture,latent) in ARMS.items():
 probe=new/('probe-'+arm)
 q=json.loads((probe/'JOINT_QUALIFIED.json').read_text())
 assert q['resume_verified'] and q['contract']['code_commit']==producer
 assert q['resume_evidence']['deterministic_reference_bitwise_exact']
 assert json.loads((probe/'IO_EQUIVALENT.json').read_text())['cpu_arrays_exact']
 assert json.loads((probe/'IO_EQUIVALENT.json').read_text())['observation_prepared_and_coverage_exact']
 assert json.loads((probe/'THROUGHPUT.json').read_text())['training_hours_for_4000_updates']<=20
 fit=json.loads((new/f'fit-{architecture}-{latent}/QUALIFIED.json').read_text())
 assert fit['code_commit']==producer
receipts=[]
for arm in ARMS:
 src=old/arm;dst=new/arm
 if dst.exists():raise FileExistsError('Refusing to overwrite a resumed arm: '+str(dst))
 dst.mkdir()
 manifest=json.loads((src/'manifest.json').read_text())
 assert manifest['code_commit']==old_producer
 migrated=copy.deepcopy(manifest);migrated['code_commit']=producer
 changes={}
 for key in ['output','qualification','joint_qualification','selection_reference']:
  value=manifest['arguments'][key]
  assert value.startswith(str(old)+'/'),(key,value)
  updated=str(new)+value[len(str(old)):]
  migrated['arguments'][key]=updated;changes[key]={'old':value,'new':updated}
 for p in src.iterdir():
  if p.is_file() and p.name not in ['joint-last.pt','manifest.json','PREEMPTED.json']:
   shutil.copy2(p,dst/p.name)
   assert digest(p)==digest(dst/p.name)
 checkpoint=torch.load(src/'joint-last.pt',map_location='cpu',weights_only=False)
 assert_exact_state(checkpoint['manifest'],manifest)
 old_sha=digest(src/'joint-last.pt')
 checkpoint['manifest']=migrated
 atomic_torch(checkpoint,dst/'joint-last.pt')
 restored=torch.load(dst/'joint-last.pt',map_location='cpu',weights_only=False)
 assert_exact_state(restored,checkpoint)
 # Re-read the retained source to verify all non-manifest state exactly.
 original=torch.load(src/'joint-last.pt',map_location='cpu',weights_only=False)
 assert original.keys()==restored.keys()
 for key in original:
  if key!='manifest':assert_exact_state(restored[key],original[key])
 assert digest(src/'joint-last.pt')==old_sha
 atomic_json(migrated,dst/'manifest.json')
 receipt={'arm':arm,'old_producer':old_producer,'producer':producer,'source':str(src/'joint-last.pt'),'source_sha256':old_sha,'destination_sha256':digest(dst/'joint-last.pt'),'global_step':checkpoint['global_step'],'task_counts':checkpoint['task_counts'],'elapsed_seconds':checkpoint['elapsed_seconds'],'changes':{'code_commit':{'old':old_producer,'new':producer},'arguments':changes},'all_other_checkpoint_state_exact':True,'source_unchanged':True}
 atomic_json(receipt,dst/'MIGRATION.json');receipts.append(receipt)
 del original,restored,checkpoint
atomic_json({'migrations':receipts,'scientific_changes':False},new/'MIGRATION_COMPLETE.json')
print(json.dumps(receipts),flush=True)
# Separate copies for the diagnostic, whose mount keeps all production read-only.
for arm in ARMS:
 target=new/'performance'/arm
 target.mkdir(parents=True)
 for name in ['joint-last.pt','manifest.json']:
  shutil.copyfile(new/arm/name,target/name)
  assert digest(new/arm/name)==digest(target/name)
  assert (new/arm/name).stat().st_ino != (target/name).stat().st_ino
atomic_json({'copies_verified':list(ARMS)},new/'performance/COPIES_VERIFIED.json')

"""Measure an isolated resume copy; no diagnostic weights enter production."""
import argparse,json,os,pathlib,statistics,threading,time
import pynvml
import torch
from samudra.experiments.early_fine_training import EarlyPilot
from samudra.experiments.observation_pilot import atomic_json
arm=pathlib.Path(os.environ['PROFILE_ARM'])
args=argparse.Namespace(**json.loads((arm/'manifest.json').read_text())['arguments'])
pilot=EarlyPilot(args)
pynvml.nvmlInit()
gpu_uuid=str(torch.cuda.get_device_properties(0).uuid)
handle=pynvml.nvmlDeviceGetHandleByUUID(gpu_uuid)
initial=pilot.completed
try:
 for future in pilot.observation_warm:future.result()
 for _ in range(20):pilot.train_update()
 pilot.timings={k:[] for k in ['recent','early','observation']}
 readings=[];stop=threading.Event()
 def monitor():
  while not stop.is_set():
   readings.append({'time':time.time(),'gpu_percent':pynvml.nvmlDeviceGetUtilizationRates(handle).gpu})
   stop.wait(1)
 thread=threading.Thread(target=monitor);thread.start()
 begin=time.monotonic()
 try:
  for _ in range(80):pilot.train_update()
  torch.cuda.synchronize()
 finally:
  stop.set();thread.join()
 elapsed=time.monotonic()-begin
 mean=statistics.mean(v['gpu_percent'] for v in readings)
 result={'arm':arm.name,'producer':os.environ['SAMUDRA_CODE_COMMIT'],'initial_step':initial,'final_step':pilot.completed,'warmup_updates':20,'measured_updates':80,'measured_seconds':elapsed,'gpu_uuid':gpu_uuid,'gpu_utilization_mean':mean,'gpu_utilization_last_half_mean':statistics.mean(v['gpu_percent'] for v in readings[len(readings)//2:]),'gpu_samples':readings,'timings':pilot.timings,'promote_diagnostic_weights':False,'utilization_gate_passed':mean>=50}
 atomic_json(result,arm/'PERFORMANCE_COMPLETE.json')
 print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in result.items() if k not in ['gpu_samples','timings']}),flush=True)
 if mean<50:raise RuntimeError('Measured GPU utilization remains below 50%; production stays blocked')
finally:
 pilot.early.prefetch.close();pilot.early.pool.shutdown(wait=True,cancel_futures=True)
 pilot.observation_warm_pool.shutdown(wait=True,cancel_futures=True)
 if pilot.wandb:pilot.wandb.finish()
